affected.product: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint for Windows

descriptions.value: Out-of-bounds read in Microsoft Defender allows an authorized attacker to disclose information locally.

Jenkins 2.587 and earlier, LTS 2.580.1 and earlier allows agents to send exceptions implementing the Stapler HttpResponse interface to the controller, resulting in a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exploitable by attackers in control of agent processes.
Server-side request forgery (ssrf) in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.
Origin validation error in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an unauthorized attacker to perform tampering locally.
Missing authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.
